exposure: postpartum and interval tubal sterilization procedures
cohort: Women older than 18 years of age undergoing surgical sterilization
finding: There was a significant increase in salpingectomy for sterilization from June 2011 to May 2016, with salpingectomy accounting for 78% of interval laparoscopic tubal sterilization procedures and 9% of intrapartum and postpartum procedures in the final year.
mod_finding: Salpingectomy instead of tubal occlusion increased at cesarean delivery from 0.1% to 9.2%, postpartum from 0% to 4.5%, and as an interval sterilization procedure from 1% to 78%.
